$$エスター$$
「Brace yourself! Everyone's wishes in this $$Ｚクリスタル$$ will defeat you!」

753:t_216:12.en:
$$トライア$$
「Let's do this, everyone! $$ソーラリアン$$, begin the attack!」

753:t_216:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hahahahaha, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You end here!!」

753:t_217:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I never thought even someone like you would become part of $c.」

753:t_217:2.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「I guess... we really look out of place...」

753:t_217:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「Shut up! I don't give a damn what that bastard says or what the world thinks!」

753:t_217:4.en:
$$ベック$$
「I'll do what I want, as much as I want! That's how I live!」

753:t_217:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「Whoa there, Mr. God! Don't say another word!」

753:t_217:7.en:
$$ベック$$
「You don't decide the plot from here on! The great $$ベック$$ will finish you off and take everything for himself!!」

753:t_218:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ノノ$$, warrior who lives eternally... All fighting will soon end.」

753:t_218:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your role is over too. I shall set you free.」

753:t_218:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Please don't talk about me like I'm a girl who can do nothing but fight!」

753:t_218:6.en:

「Please don't talk about me like I'm a girl who can do nothing but fight!」

753:t_218:9.en:

「I'll have you know, $$ノノ$$ has all sorts of things she wants to do when there's peace!」

753:t_218:10.en:

753:t_218:11.en:

「I want to go shopping with Big Sis, eat delicious food with Big Sis, travel with Big Sis and see swans...」

753:t_218:12.en:

「I want to go shopping with Big Sis, eat delicious food with Big Sis, travel with Big Sis and see swans...」

753:t_218:13.en:

「I want to go shopping with Big Sis, eat delicious food with Big Sis, travel with Big Sis and see swans...」

753:t_218:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Anyway! $$ノノ$$ won't let someone like you get in the way of her plans for life!」

753:t_218:15.en:

「Anyway! $$ノノ$$ won't let someone like you get in the way of her plans for life!」

753:t_218:16.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Anyway! $$ノノ$$ won't let someone like you get in the way of her plans for life!」

753:t_218:17.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How sad... All those dreams will come to nothing when the universe perishes...」

753:t_218:18.en:

「That's why I'm fighting to defeat you and stop the universe's collapse!」

753:t_218:20.en:

753:t_218:21.en:

758:t_1:4.en:
$$エスター$$
「You've finished refitting the $$ソーラリアン$$.」

758:t_1:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「The main work is done.」

758:t_1:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ vanished with $$ＡＧ$$, but it can still control events to a degree. That ship has a new job waiting for it too.」

758:t_1:7.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「A new $$天柱$$ linking parallel worlds has appeared near Earth, along with a gate to control it...」

758:t_1:8.en:
$$エスター$$
「We can travel to all sorts of parallel worlds through it.」

758:t_1:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. That's the form of the new world born from that space-time repair...」

758:t_1:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「I call it the hyperdimensional world.」

758:t_1:11.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Humanity will spread not only into outer space, but into parallel worlds too.」

758:t_1:12.en:
$$エスター$$
「Looks like we'll see everyone from $c who went home to their own worlds much sooner than I thought.」

758:t_1:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「Still, the theory is far ahead of the practical work.」

758:t_1:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「Relatively close worlds are one thing, but contacting every parallel world won't be so easy.」

758:t_1:15.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「That's why we need people to pass through the gate and explore new worlds.」

758:t_1:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「According to $$ツィーネ$$ at the $$ゲート管理局$$, people in each world have had similar ideas. Access requests are coming in one after another.」

758:t_1:17.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ was disbanded, and the soldiers went back to their own worlds too.」

758:t_1:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$サルディアス$$ contacted me the other day. The $$御使い$$s' disappearance freed $$サイデリアル$$'s soldiers too, and the fighting has ended across the galaxy...」

758:t_1:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... He did say there's no telling how long the peace will last.」

758:t_1:20.en:
$$エスター$$
「That old guy... He has to add something unnecessary right to the end...」

758:t_1:21.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「People who overcame the fighting can prove him wrong through their efforts.」

758:t_1:22.en:
$$トライア$$
「At least the world will change... We'll cross stars and dimensions, understand and accept others... and move toward the future together...」

758:t_1:23.en:
$$トライア$$
「Once we've grasped the truth, all that's left is to act on it.」

758:t_1:24.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「The gate is the culmination of that.」

758:t_1:25.en:
$$エスター$$
「It'll be an adventure across dimensions, full of dreams and romance...」

758:t_1:26.en:
$$トライア$$
「How about it, $$クロウ$$? Why not dream of striking it rich and volunteer as a $$ゲートトラベラー$$?」

758:t_1:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'll pass. I won't rely on that kind of gamble. I'll just pay back my debt steadily.」

758:t_1:28.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「How much do you have left? I heard it fell below 500,000 G at one point...」

758:t_1:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I couldn't help it... Repairing the $$リ・ブラスタ$$'s damage from the final battle cost money.」

758:t_1:32.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... That's how it goes. The machine was supposed to be scrapped after its job was done, but you asked for it to be repaired.」

758:t_1:33.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I haven't sunk so low I'd abandon my partner.」

758:t_1:34.en:
$$トライア$$
(I don't dislike that side of you... That's why I had the lab cover 80% of the costs.)

758:t_1:35.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「But now the fighting's over and there are no $$次元獣$$s, how will you repay the debt...?」

758:t_1:36.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I've got a few ideas. I could be a mercenary, or start an aerobatics team...」

758:t_1:37.en:
$$トライア$$
「Take your time thinking it over. The fighting's over for now, after all.」

758:t_1:38.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you really can't think of anything, I'll send you jobs from the lab like before.」

758:t_1:39.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「You could also join a $$火星$$ settlement expedition.」

758:t_1:40.en:
$$エスター$$
「Why not work with me as an assistant for $$次元力|lc$$ research?」

758:t_1:42.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's good to have hope, but don't forget the 1,000,000 G.」

758:t_1:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The world changes, but I don't... huh...」

758:t_1:45.en:
$$クロウ$$
(There's a future full of hope, and peace... If the possibilities are infinite, I should be able to repay even 1,000,000 G...)

758:t_1:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I don't know when that'll be, though...)
